label: Samsung QN90B Neo QLED 4K smart TV
description: Samsung QN90B is a Neo QLED 4K Tizen smart TV with 4 HDMI 2.1 ports, SmartThings hub support and an IP control / web API. It has both network paths: a real RJ45 LAN port (100M Ethernet, wired to the one-connect style input panel) plus built-in Wi-Fi 5 802.11ac, so it can be cabled or associated; the HDMI, USB and optical ports are not network interfaces.
